caption: The loop on the worked example: the parity language written as 0*(10*10*)*, built into an ε-NFA, converted to the two-state DFA (q0 even and final, q1 odd), then read back as the same formula by Arden's rule. Every arrow keeps the language fixed, and that language holds 8 strings of length at most 3.

spec.title: One language, three notations: even number of 1s
spec.aria: A three-step cycle on the worked example: the regular expression 0*(10*10*)* goes to an epsilon-NFA by Thompson's construction, that NFA goes to the two-state DFA with q0 even and final and q1 odd by subset construction, and the DFA goes back to the same regular expression by Arden's rule, with every arrow preserving the language of strings having an even number of 1s.
